start.title: アダムの息子たち
start.text:
あなたはアダムとエバの長男として目覚めます。
あなたの後に、次男アベルが生まれます。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Live as the firstborn son of Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:1-2 — Eve gave birth to Cain, and then to his brother Abel.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Be born before Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Adam and Eve came first; Cain was their son.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Grow up as an only child
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain had a brother, Abel.

fields.title: あなたの仕事
fields.text:
年月が過ぎます。兄弟たちはそれぞれ自分の仕事を見つけます。
あなたの仕事は何ですか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Work the ground as a tiller of the soil
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Keep flocks of sheep like Abel
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Abel kept flocks; Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Refuse to work at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain worked the ground.

abel_pasture.title: あなたの兄弟の仕事
abel_pasture.text:
あなたは野原の向こうにアベルを見ます。
彼は何をしていますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] See Abel keeping flocks of sheep
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:2 — Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] See Abel tilling the ground beside you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Abel kept flocks, not that he tilled the ground.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] See Abel fishing at the river
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis does not describe Abel fishing.

offerings.title: 祭壇の前で
offerings.text:
主に供え物をする時が来ました。
あなたは何を持って行きますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Bring some of the fruits of the soil as an offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Bring a firstborn lamb from your flock
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Abel brought a lamb; Cain brought fruits of the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Bring nothing at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain did bring an offering, though not the best.

accepted.title: 主の配慮
accepted.text:
あなたは主が二つの供え物をご覧になるのを待ちます。
何が起こりますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] The Lord looks with favor on Abel and his offering, but not on yours
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:4-5 — The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering, but on Cain and his offering He did not look with favor.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] The Lord favors both offerings equally
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the Lord favored Abel's offering, not both.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] The Lord accepts your offering and rejects Abel's
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the opposite — the Lord favored Abel's offering.

anger.title: あなたの顔は落ちる
anger.text:
供え物は終わりました。何かあなたの中で湧き上がってきます。
どのように反応しますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Become very angry, your face downcast
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:5 — Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Rejoice with Abel over his accepted offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain became angry, not that he rejoiced.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Bring a better offering the very next day
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis does not describe Cain bringing a second offering.

warning.title: 罪が戸口にうずくまる
warning.text:
主はあなたに語りかけます。
主は何と言われますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] 'Sin is crouching at your door — but you must rule over it'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:6-7 — The Lord warned Cain that sin was crouching at his door and he must rule over it.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] 'Bring a lamb instead of grain'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis does not record the Lord telling Cain to bring a lamb.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Nothing — the Lord is silent
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says the Lord did speak to Cain about sin at the door.

invitation.title: あなたは兄弟に話しかける
invitation.text:
アベルは信頼して近くを歩いています。
あなたは何と言いますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Say to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:8 — Cain said to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field.'

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Invite Abel to worship at the altar together
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain led Abel out to the field, not to the altar.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Send Abel away and never speak to him again
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain called Abel to the field, not that he sent him away.

field.title: 野原で
field.text:
あなたとアベルは、開けた野原に二人きりです。
あなたはどうしますか？

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Attack Abel your brother and kill him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:8 — Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Argue with Abel and then forgive him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain killed Abel; he did not forgive him.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Walk home without touching him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain killed Abel in the field.

confrontation.title: 「あなたの兄弟はどこにいるのか？」
confrontation.text:
主の声があなたに届きます。
「あなたの兄弟アベルはどこにいるのか？」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Answer: 'I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'I don't know. Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Confess plainly: 'I have killed him'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain denied knowing; he did not confess plainly.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Stay silent before the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis says Cain answered the Lord; he did not stay silent.

wanderer.title: 安らぎなき放浪者
wanderer.text:
主はあなたを守るための印をつけられます。
あなたはエデンの東、ノドの地をさまよい出ます。
